title: Mall world movie theatre and the quad island cities
content: Hey, I had no idea that people dreamt of mall world. I often visit a mall that is attached to an airport terminal. In that mall is a movie theatre that has carpeted walls and posters lining a halfway that curved as it ushers you into the back concessions area. What I really want to know is if anyone has encountered a city that is four separate sections of land. Three are islands and one is a peninsula and they are all connected connected by long bridges. This is always in a coastal area, and the peninsula is the entrance to the city and it is at the end of a long coastal highway (along which is a set of caves with human remains). There are museums, shopping centers, an amusement park, a zoo, multiple beaches, etc. There are always boats going in-between the islands. In one dream I went to a museum with three stories and one of the sections was about maritime history and there was a submarine hanging fron the ceiling. In the back offices of this museum, where I have visited many times in other dreams, is a room with what looks like a theatre stage with a backdrop. But the backdrop, upon investigation, is a window looking out of a something orbiting earth. From there you can launch your consciousness to earth and inhabit a mind. Nas when I do so I fly to earth and when I inhabit a body I wake up in bed. Any thoughts or similarities?
